sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.4791 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against them in FIR No.337 of 2018 on the file of Kancharapalem P.S., Visakhapatnam.
The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 273 IPC and Section 59(i) (ii) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard Sri R. Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in FIR No.337 of 2018 on the file of Kancharapalem P.S., Visakhapatnam, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

_ D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J 9th August, 2019 cbs HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU CRIMINAL PETITION No.4791 of 2019 9th August, 2019 cbs J.Laxmana Rao vs State Of Ap on 9 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29323484/
